info.title: Proposales API
info.description: Create and manage Proposales content, companies, templates, proposals, attachments, and inbound requests. All monetary values are represented in the smallest currency unit unless an operation states otherwise.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: Files available in the content library.

tags.name: Content
tags.description: Products and videos in the content library.

tags.name: Proposals
tags.description: Proposal drafts, versions, metadata, and search.

get.description: Returns attachments available to the authenticated user. Optionally limits the result to one accessible company.

post.description: Creates an inbound request for proposal for the inbox identified by the path token. This public operation accepts JSON, URL-encoded forms, or multipart form data. Unknown form fields are retained as proposal metadata.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Public inbox token for the receiving company.

get.description: Returns every company the authenticated user is an active member of.
Returns active proposal templates for a company the authenticated user can access.
Returns products and videos from the content library. Product and variation filters may be comma-separated. Detailed image data is included when filtering by variation ID.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Integration unique identifier or Oracle product code. Requires company_id unless the request is scoped by variation_id or by a product_id that resolves for this token.

parameters.name: variation_id
parameters.description: One variation ID or a comma-separated list of variation IDs.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: One product ID or a comma-separated list of product IDs.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Include archived content and its is_archived field.

post.description: Creates one content item when action is omitted. When action=restore, restores the archived products selected by product_ids or variation_ids. The request schema depends on the action parameter.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Set to restore to restore archived content. Omit to create content.

requestBody.description: A content item when action is omitted, or a set of IDs when action=restore.

201.description: Content item created when action is omitted.

put.description: Updates an active or archived content item selected by product_id or variation_id.

delete.description: Archives one item when product_id or variation_id is supplied. When action=bulk, archives every accessible product selected in the JSON body. Both forms are idempotent.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Set to bulk to select multiple items from the request body.

parameters.name: variation_id
parameters.description: Variation to archive when action is omitted. Either variation_id or product_id is required for a single-item request.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Product to archive when action is omitted. Either product_id or variation_id is required for a single-item request.

200.description: Content archived. A bulk request returns BulkArchiveResponse; a single-item request returns ArchiveContentResponse.

post.description: Creates a new proposal series with an editable draft.

get.description: Returns a proposal by UUID when the authenticated user belongs to its company.

post.description: Creates or updates the next draft version in the same proposal series. Repeated calls return the same draft until that draft is sent or archived. company_id and language are required by the API.

patch.description: Partially updates a draft or template in place. The body must contain company_id and at least one field to update. Blocks replace the full ordered block list when supplied.
Shallow-merges keys into the proposal data object. A null value removes its key; omitted keys remain unchanged.

get.description: Returns up to 25 proposals ordered by updated_at descending. Any query parameter named filter[property] matches that property in the proposal data object.

parameters.name: filter[property_name]
parameters.description: Example metadata filter. Replace property_name with a key from the proposal data object.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of proposals to return.

parameters.name: exclude_revision_drafts
parameters.description: Exclude draft revisions from series that already have recipient tokens.

bearerAuth.description: Proposales API token. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

CompanyIdQuery.name: company_id
CompanyIdQuery.description: Limit results to a company available to the API token.

BadRequest.description: The request could not be validated or is missing required data.

Unauthorized.description: The API token is missing or invalid, or the user cannot access the resource.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated API role does not have permission to perform this operation.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist or is not available to the caller.

Conflict.description: The resource is in a state that does not permit this operation.

ServerError.description: The server could not complete the request.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, when the error has one (e.g. `INVALID_RECIPIENT`, `INVALID_CONTACT_EMAIL`).

issues.description: Per-field validation issues when request validation fails.

created_at.description: Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
Creation time as a Unix timestamp.

deactivated_at.description: Archive time as a Unix timestamp, or null for active content.

uuid.description: Uploadcare UUID, or an empty string when url is supplied.

url.description: Public image URL used when uuid is empty.

DiscountDecimals.description: How many decimals the discount badge shows, e.g. 12.5% displays as -13% with 0, -12.5% with 1 or 2. Trailing zeros are hidden. New proposals inherit the company's setting; new versions keep the source proposal's setting.

data_prefill.description: Prefill data consumed by the configured invoicing form.

ProposalData.description: Integration-defined proposal metadata. Values may be nested and null removes a key during a data patch.

uuid.description: Preserves editor-owned changes when updating an existing block.

blocks.description: Complete ordered replacement list. title, description, and image_uuids are ignored by this operation.

description_html.description: HTML rendered from `description_md`. Any HTML in the text is escaped, so the only markup is the paragraphs, line breaks, bold and headings that the formatting produces.
